recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血液中見到一顆核質比高、染色質細緻、胞質少且帶小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic bleb）的芽細胞，結合唐氏症嬰兒、白血球與血小板增加的臨床資料，符合唐氏症相關暫時性異常骨髓生成（TAM）。
features: Single medium-sized blast with very high N:C ratio and round nucleus
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this magnification
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a small cytoplasmic bleb/bud (megakaryoblast-like)
Numerous platelets including a large, pale granular platelet form
Background red cells with prominent crenation (echinocytes), likely partly artifactual, and occasional polychromatic macrocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a neonate shows a circulating blast with a very high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing a small cytoplasmic bleb, a feature suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. Platelets are numerous, with occasional large forms. Red cells show marked crenation, likely related to smear preparation, with occasional polychromatic cells. In a neonate with Down syndrome, leukocytosis, thrombocytosis and 18-19% myeloid blasts (CD33+, CD117+), findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; GATA1 mutation testing and follow-up are recommended.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: ML-DS usually presents after the neonatal period (typically before age 4) with cytopenias and marrow fibrosis, whereas TAM presents in the first weeks and often resolves spontaneously; morphology of the blasts is similar.

ddx.dx: Congenital acute megakaryoblastic leukemia without Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Non-DS congenital AMKL lacks trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation, frequently carries RBM15::MRTFA, and does not regress spontaneously.

ddx.dx: Neonatal reactive leukocytosis with circulating immature cells
ddx.vs: Reactive states show left-shifted granulocytes and nucleated red cells but lack a clonal CD34/CD117+ megakaryoblastic blast population.
Lymphoid cells have more condensed chromatin and lack cytoplasmic blebs, and express B- or T-cell rather than myeloid/megakaryocytic markers.
